questions.question_text: Provide a detailed summary (80-100 words) of 'Ila Sachani: Embroidering Dreams with Her Feet', highlighting the character actions and moral outcome.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Born without functional hands, young Ila felt isolated when she could not hold chalk or draw in sand. Refusing defeat, she systematically trained her toes to perform daily chores like eating, writing, and combing hair. Fascinated by Kathiawar embroidery, she spent endless hours practicing until she mastered threading needles with her toes. She created magnificent garments with peacocks, floral motifs, and mirror work. Exhibiting her art statewide, she won awards and achieved financial self-reliance.

Guided Writing Extension: Write an inspirational profile (80-100 words) of Ila Sachani.
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
Format: Biographical Profile. Key Value Points: Born without functional hands, Trained toes for daily life and embroidery, Achieved national recognition.
